annot://schema/guide-beat/v1.description: One measured beat. The time is the reference's point interval.

index.description: Position in the measured beat sequence, 0-based.
index.title: Index

annot://schema/guide-beat/v1.title: GuideBeatBodyV1

annot://schema/guide-cue/v1.description: A landmark the learner can hear or watch for, anchored to a step.

at_resolved.description: True when the cue's wall-clock position in that source is known, in which case the reference is a point at it. False means the annotation sits at tick 0 because there is nothing better — the one bit that keeps 'at second zero' distinct from 'unknown'.
at_resolved.title: At Resolved

doc_id.description: Which guide this cue belongs to.
doc_id.title: Doc Id

duration_value.description: How long the cue lasts, in the domain unit.
duration_value.title: Duration Value

offset_value.description: Offset into the step, in the domain unit. RELATIVE, always — an absolute cue time is computed by ``resolve()``, never stored.
offset_value.title: Offset Value

ordinal.description: Position in the document's cue list, 0-based.
ordinal.title: Ordinal

source.description: Which source the cue was heard in, when known.
source.title: Source

step_id.description: The step this cue is anchored to.
step_id.title: Step Id

text.description: What the learner hears or reads.
text.title: Text

annot://schema/guide-cue/v1.title: GuideCueBodyV1

annot://schema/guide-doc/v1.description: The guide's envelope: identity, presentation language, and the run.

attrs.description: Namespaced open bag, as on the document.
attrs.title: Attrs

credits.description: Attribution line, when there is one.
credits.title: Credits

doc_id.description: Stable slug of the guide within a project. Distinct from the annotation id, and the field that lets one store hold several guides over the same asset.
doc_id.title: Doc Id

flags.description: The run's honesty flags (``Segmentation.flags``) — 'naming-abstained', 'origin-estimated: ...', and friends. Evidence about the run, never projected into the document.
flags.title: Flags

lang.description: BCP-47 language tag of the guide's prose.
lang.title: Lang

method.description: Which segmentation capability produced the steps (``Segmentation.method``). Empty when unrecorded.
method.title: Method

schema_version.description: Version of the StepDocument schema this was projected at.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

annot://schema/guide-doc/v1.title: GuideDocBodyV1

annot://schema/guide-grid/v1.description:
How the domain unit relates to wall-clock time, over the region it governs.

The document's ``metric`` is projected straight back out of this — one
grid, one source of truth, no second copy in the document envelope.

beat_count.description: How many beats were actually tracked, when the grid was measured rather than supplied. None means nobody counted.
beat_count.title: Beat Count

doc_id.description: Which guide this grid governs. The grid is per-guide, not per-asset: two guides can count the same video differently.
doc_id.title: Doc Id

method.description: Which capability produced the grid ('grid-measured', 'grid-placed'). Empty when the caller supplied it outright.
method.title: Method

tempo_bpm.description: Tempo as a decimal string. None spells 'tempo unknown' — never '0'.
tempo_bpm.title: Tempo Bpm

unit.description: The domain unit counted: eight | bar | rep.
unit.title: Unit

annot://schema/guide-grid/v1.title: GuideGridBodyV1

annot://schema/guide-pass/v1.description: A stretch of one source with a single character (music, speech, ...).

detector.description: What produced the split ('mixing.find_segments:speech_music'). Empty when the caller supplied passes without saying.
detector.title: Detector

label.description: What this stretch is: 'music' | 'speech' | '' when the detector found a segment it would not name.
label.title: Label

annot://schema/guide-pass/v1.title: GuidePassBodyV1

annot://schema/guide-recipe/v1.description: One span's derivation parameters, keyed by the span address.

box.description: The resolved crop box (x, y, w, h) in pixels, as decimal strings. None means full frame — a recorded decision, not a gap.
box.title: Box

doc_id.description: Which guide this recipe belongs to.
doc_id.title: Doc Id

frame_height.description: Source frame height the box is in.
frame_height.title: Frame Height

frame_width.description: Source frame width the box is in.
frame_width.title: Frame Width

locator.description: Which subject locator resolved the box ('full_frame', ...).
locator.title: Locator

locked.description: A human set this box; reconcile must not re-derive it.
locked.title: Locked

media_digest.description: What the stored media was actually cut with (box + window + source hash). A hand-edited box or a re-timed window changes it and forces a re-encode instead of serving stale bytes.
media_digest.title: Media Digest

params.description: Policy parameters the box was resolved under (aspect, pad). A change here re-locates an unlocked entry.
params.title: Params

source_asset_id.description: Hash of the media cut from. None = identity unverified.
source_asset_id.title: Source Asset Id

span_key.description: The span address ``{step_id}/{source}/{role}/{start}`` — the same key ``paces.derivation`` writes into the committed sidecar, so the two layers join without a translation table.
span_key.title: Span Key

step_id.description: The step this recipe derives media for.
step_id.title: Step Id

annot://schema/guide-recipe/v1.title: GuideRecipeBodyV1

annot://schema/guide-source/v1.description: One input the guide's spans refer into.

asset_id.description: Content hash of a local copy, if any.
asset_id.title: Asset Id

doc_id.description: Which guide this source belongs to — one store can hold several guides over the same asset, and a projection has to read back only its own.
doc_id.title: Doc Id

duration_s.description: Source duration in seconds, as a decimal string.
duration_s.title: Duration S

ordinal.description: Position in the document's source list, 0-based.
ordinal.title: Ordinal

rights.description: Usage rights. First-class in this domain (``docs/07 §8.7``): a guide that restyles someone's choreography has to say so.
rights.title: Rights

source_id.description: Slug of the source within the guide. Not the annotation id.
source_id.title: Source Id

annot://schema/guide-source/v1.title: GuideSourceBodyV1

annot://schema/guide-step/v1.description: One step's presence in one span (or its absence from every span).

attrs.description: Namespaced open bag, as on the step.
attrs.title: Attrs

doc_id.description: Which guide this step belongs to.
doc_id.title: Doc Id

duration_unit.description: The domain unit: eight | rep | second.
duration_unit.title: Duration Unit

duration_value.description: Duration in the domain's own unit, as a decimal string.
duration_value.title: Duration Value

name.description: The step's name. Empty means found-but-not-named, a valid state.
name.title: Name

ordinal.description: Position among siblings, 0-based. Order is semantic.
ordinal.title: Ordinal

parent_step_id.description: Enclosing step's id; None for a top-level step.
parent_step_id.title: Parent Step Id

repeat.description: How many times the children cycle.
repeat.title: Repeat

span_caption.description: Prose about THIS span, not about the step.
span_caption.title: Span Caption

span_count.description: How many spans the step has, so a reader can tell rows apart.
span_count.title: Span Count

span_index.description: Which of the step's spans this annotation is, 0-based. None means the step has no spans at all and this is its only row.
span_index.title: Span Index

span_open_ended.description: The span recorded a start but no end — a deep link, not an interval. The reference interval is then a point at the start, and this flag is what keeps that distinct from a zero-length span.
span_open_ended.title: Span Open Ended

span_source.description: Slug of the source the span refers into.
span_source.title: Span Source

step_id.description: Stable id within the guide ('b4'). Distinct from the annotation id — document ids are slugs, store ids are UUIDs, and the two are related by this field, never conflated.
step_id.title: Step Id

variant_of.description: Another angle on that step, not a new step.
variant_of.title: Variant Of

annot://schema/guide-step/v1.title: GuideStepBodyV1
